name: Keyboard (No Exception)
explanation: This is the stricter, no-exceptions version of SC 2.1.1 Keyboard. The Level A version allows one narrow exception for functions that inherently depend on the path of a movement, like freehand drawing. This AAA criterion removes that exception entirely: every single piece of functionality, without exception, must be operable from a keyboard. In practice this means path-dependent interactions either need a fully keyboard-operable alternative or the feature can't be offered at all if it can't meet this bar.
whoItAffects: The same population as SC 2.1.1 — keyboard-only users, switch-device users, and voice-control users who emulate keyboard input — benefits further here. Meeting this AAA criterion closes the small remaining gap left by the Level A exception, covering the rare cases like freehand signature capture or gesture-based drawing tools that would otherwise remain keyboard-inaccessible even on an otherwise fully compliant site.

codeExample.bad:
<!-- A freehand signature pad with no keyboard-operable alternative -->
<canvas id="signature-pad" aria-label="Draw your signature"></canvas>
<!-- Mouse/touch drawing only; there is no other way to provide a signature -->
codeExample.good:
<!-- The signature pad remains for mouse/touch users, but a fully
     keyboard-operable alternative satisfies the input requirement -->
<canvas id="signature-pad" aria-label="Draw your signature"></canvas>
<button type="button" id="type-signature">Type your name instead</button>
<!-- Typing a name is a keyboard-operable equivalent path to the same
     underlying requirement: providing a signature -->

howToTest: Identify any feature on the page that depends on the path of a pointer movement rather than just its start and end point — freehand drawing, gesture-based games, signature capture. For each one, check whether a keyboard-only user has some way to accomplish the same underlying task, even if the interaction looks different, such as typing a name instead of drawing a signature. If no keyboard path exists at all for that functionality, it fails this criterion.

check.question: A site offers a freehand drawing tool for annotating photos, usable only with a mouse or touchscreen, with no keyboard-operable alternative for adding annotations. Does this meet SC 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)?
choices: Yes, because freehand drawing is exempted the same way it is under SC 2.1.1
No, because this AAA criterion has no path-dependent exception, so an equivalent keyboard-operable way to annotate is required
Yes, because AAA criteria are optional and never required for conformance
It depends on whether the tool also supports touch input
